findings.title: Loading gate does not cover all dashboard queries
findings.description: `isLoading` only waits on `overviewLoading || revenueLoading || salesLoading || forecastLoading`. `comparisonLoading` (used for Revenue, Active Pipeline, Deals Won, Conversion Rate) and `analyticsOverview` (used for Outstanding/Overdue Amount) are not included, so the polished KPI cards can render with $0 values while those queries are still loading. This is pre-existing but is now more visible because the cards are interactive links.

residual_risks.title: Whole-card links can break if interactive children are added later
residual_risks.description: The KPI cards are now wrapped in `<Link>` with `group block`. Today the inner `<Card>` contains no buttons, menus, or nested anchors, so it is valid HTML and keyboard-navigable. If future UI adds interactive children inside the card (e.g., a '...' menu, a second action link, or a copy button), it will create invalid nested anchors and break screen-reader/keyboard behavior.

residual_risks.title: Standalone 'Deals Needing Attention' callout removed
residual_risks.description: The diff removes the conditional `overview.agingDeals` card from the dashboard page. The data is still rendered inside `<InsightsWidget overview={overview} />`, so the information is not lost, but the standalone callout is gone. This is an intentional data-behavior change, not a logic bug.

testing_gaps.title: No tests for new link behavior
testing_gaps.description: There are no automated checks that KPI cards route to /deals or /invoices and that activity rows route to /activities. A simple Playwright or component test should assert hrefs and keyboard reachability.

testing_gaps.title: No a11y validation for nested links
testing_gaps.description: Because the whole card is now a link, an a11y lint rule or manual check should verify no nested interactive elements are introduced inside KPI or activity cards.
